runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Paint ONE precisely registered 1024 x 1024 RGBA texture-source image of the empty Graft-serum vat, LEFT orthographic view.

INPUTS:
Image 1 guide_left.png: EDIT TARGET. This is the exact existing 3D model. Keep this image's geometry and alpha mask unchanged.
Image 2 design_reference.png: approved colour and surface-material reference ONLY.
Image 3 concept_crop.png: supporting original concept ONLY.

REQUIRED NATIVE CANVAS: 1024 x 1024 pixels, same as Image 1, unresized. Retain Image 1's exact placement: object alpha bounding box x=66..957 and y=150..873. Repaint the existing pixels without changing silhouette, scale, framing, projection, any polygon edge, opening, detail or transparent pixel. Do not use the design reference's three-quarter camera. Keep the orthographic left side view of the guide, including its large opening on the RIGHT side. Do not fill that opening. Keep all existing claw tips, feet, angular ribs and hanging membrane edges in precisely the guide's positions. Do not add protrusions, membrane holes or tears that change the guide geometry. Nothing outside the guide silhouette, nothing cropped.

SURFACE PAINT: Transfer the design reference's dull black-violet Kreegan resin with fine ridges, pale ivory bone claws, torn dry grey-violet membrane flaps, and dark dry hollow interior onto the guide's corresponding existing surfaces. Retain fine painted cracks, fibres and ridges as albedo detail without changing geometry. The vat is empty and dry, no liquid. Existing orange seam details may have their intrinsic orange colour, with no light spill and no added glowing parts.

CRITICAL LIGHTING: this is ALBEDO for texture projection, not a beauty render. Use completely flat, even, shadowless illumination from the viewer. Matte intrinsic surface colours. Remove the guide's grey shading and the design reference's directional lighting: NO cast shadows, NO ambient-occlusion darkening, NO strong specular highlights, NO reflections, NO rim light, NO bright edge streaks. Do not darken creases as lighting; keep only intrinsic material colour and fine texture detail.

BACKGROUND: genuinely transparent RGBA alpha exactly where the guide is transparent, including its opening. No black background, no checkerboard pixels, no floor or ground shadow, no labels or text. Return ONE complete native 1024 x 1024 PNG.
runs.reason: Not selected: wrong native size, altered geometry and stronger glossy highlights than the corrective return.

checks.materials_and_colours: Black-violet body, ivory claws, grey-violet membranes and dark dry interior are present; resin reads too much like cracked stone and some material boundaries drift.
checks.lighting_review: Bright edges, glossy highlights and contact shading remain.
checks.geometry_review: Guide silhouette and internal edges are not exact; claw shapes, membrane boundaries and aperture contour drift.
